blockingIssues.description: `testBatchRenderFailureDowngradesToFrameSameSession` only proves frame-backend attachment after fallback, not that the triggering frame was actually rendered via the frame path, so VAL-RENDER-004 remains unproven.

The pointer, wheel, keyboard, and focus-loss host tests mostly assert that calls do not crash instead of proving coordinate conversion or runtime event routing, leaving VAL-CROSS-004/005/006 unvalidated.

`testResizeUpdatesLogicalSizeWithScaleFactor` rechecks the injected surface descriptor instead of exercising resize/DPI propagation through host and runtime state, so VAL-CROSS-003 is only partially covered.

The VAL-CROSS-009 tests do not verify refresh-rate propagation or timer enable/disable behavior; they only inspect `useHighResolutionTimer` or a local cadence helper, so regressions in host pacing could still pass.

The VAL-CROSS-010 tests are placeholders that neither register observed dependencies nor assert reload/presentation counts after notifications, so same-turn coalescing and dependency filtering remain unproven.
